oracle-l5r-2853: Goju Kobashi: "Battle: Target an enemy attachment: Kobashi consumes it. Destroy it. You may target one of your Ninja, create a 1F Shadowlands . Ninja Follower, and attach it to him." Two blockers. (1) The created Follower is the Proxy scan Kobashi's Spawn (oracle-l5r-10008, decision 2026-09-20-created-cards-from-proxy-scans.md pairs it with this card), but its scan is not in the local scan set: assets/reference/oracle/emperor-edition/receipts/oracle-l5r-10008-printing-1-image-1.json has no working_copy block, the original master under assets/reference/oracle/emperor-edition/images/ does not exist in a worktree, and no L5R-Catalogue-WebP85.zip on this machine contains the file (looked up by the receipt's sha256 c4db3440...), so the Proxy cannot be packaged (tools/content/package_vanilla_wave.py needs the image) and CreatedCards.Resolve would fail. Once the webp is restored, publish it as a CreatedOnly Follower (Force 1, keywords Shadowlands and Ninja) and the rest is data: an enemy-attachment target ("any-attachment" filtered to enemy cards), DestroyAttachment, and an optional second slot (0..1) on "own-ninja-personality" carrying Creates: new(CardType.Follower, Force: 1, Keywords: ["Shadowlands", "Ninja"]) -- the shape of Makubesu's/Iaimiko's optional slot. (2) "Kobashi consumes it" is not defined anywhere in docs/rules/EMPEROR_EDITION_CORE_RULES.md (Consumer is a printed keyword with no rules text; this card is the only user of the verb). Reading it as flavor for the destroy would be the smallest faithful reading, but it is a ruling for Mendon, not an inference to bake in.
oracle-l5r-7618: Suiteiru no Oni: "Open: Destroy your target unbowed Personality: Create a number of 1F Shadowlands . Nonhuman . Oni Followers equal to his Chi. Attach them to one or more of your Personalities. Lose Honor equal to the number of Followers this created." Blockers: (1) the created Follower is the Proxy scan Suiteiru's Podling (oracle-l5r-10021), whose scan is not in the local scan set (receipt oracle-l5r-10021-printing-1-image-1.json has no working_copy block; the original master is absent from a worktree and not in any local L5R-Catalogue-WebP85.zip, sha256 65c50653...), so it cannot be packaged as a CreatedOnly Follower. (2) A created COUNT computed from the destroyed Personality's Chi does not exist: CreatedCardSpec.Count is a constant. It could be built as a CountFrom (Target Chi, read before the destroy cost removes him, like Abodan's _abodanChoseDead capture) beside CreatedValue. (3) "Attach them to one or more of your Personalities" needs a variable number of hosts (1..N, N up to the count), where Makubesu's slot is fixed at one or two; the hosts would be a slot with Max = the count, dealt in turn (CreatedCardSpec's non-PerHost distribution already deals Count cards across the chosen hosts). (4) "Lose Honor equal to the number of Followers this created" needs the created count read back after creation (a created card that is refused, e.g. by Unique/Honor Requirement attach legality, is not counted). A destroyed target that is not in play again (unbowed check as a cost) and a Chi of 0 (creates nothing, lose 0) are the edge cases to pin.
